profile.headline: Driven Software Engineer with multiple Patents | Fluent in C, C++, Python | Ex-developer at Bose
profile.geoLocationName: Princeton Junction, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: Highly talented, proactive, and solutions-focused software engineer with track record of success in dynamic industries and 10+ years of experience spanning embedded systems, mobile apps, and algorithm implementation. Outstanding collaborator able to work effectively alongside stakeholders in various disciplines and deliver contributions that drive engineering teams to achieve project goals. Dedicated to adopting and leveraging new technologies to maximize efficiency and produce innovative applications. Hold Secret Security Clearance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Hired by one of the largest aerospace and defense manufacturers in the world to develop software application in C for X-band radar (XBR) missile defense system. Contributed to 6-person team in charge of implementing signal processing algorithm using Scrum methodology.
positions.insights: Skills: Configuration Management · Agile Methodologies · MATLAB · Programming · Data Analysis · Software Design · Python (Programming Language) · C++ · C (Programming Language) · SQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Originally worked as embedded software engineer creating firmware for Bluetooth headset line. After acquiring mobile app development skills, contributed to Bose Connect app using Objective-C and Swift programming languages. Executed numerous initiatives from original concept/design through development and release.

Project Highlights:
	Bose Accessory Framework – Rapid Prototype Platform: Collaborated with team of engineers, UI designers, and stakeholders to create backend framework to expedite prototyping of new features for Bluetooth headset.
-	After completing iOS app development bootcamp, launched mobile app platform using Swift to communicate with and modify behavior of Bluetooth headset.
-	Prototyped 15+ concepts using this framework.
	Cloud-Based Data Collection Platform: Assisted algorithm development team with formulating convenient and secure way to capture and store data from Bose Bluetooth device while on the go.
-	Devised solution using mobile device to compile and save data on Amazon Web Services (AWS) S3 bucket.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Configuration Management · Software Infrastructure · Agile Methodologies · C# · Programming · Data Analysis · Software Design · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C (Programming Language) · Algorithms

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Recruited by provider of innovative signal processing solutions for use in signals intelligence and electronic warfare applications. Assisted with multiple projects and supplied development expertise in C++, C, and C#.
Project Highlights:
	Improvised Explosive Device Diffusion System: Created real-time client-server application with GUI and played key role throughout entire project, performing all hardware/software integration, troubleshooting issues, and conducting field testing.
-	Constructed application to interface with third-party hardware and implemented complex signal processing algorithm to locate GSM signal.
-	Simulated GSM signal and verified performance of detection algorithm in MATLAB.
-	Refactored and designed new GUI in QT for signal analysis application.
	WinDemod System: Redesigned application for platform-independent implementation using QT.
-	Ported legacy code over into new application and implemented telecommunication protocols such as V.42bis data compression algorithm.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Programming · Data Analysis · C++ · C (Programming Language) · Algorithms

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Enlisted on contract basis with US DoD federally funded research and development lab. Created GUI-based application to process and analyze large set of image signals. Applied various image processing techniques. Evaluated performance of FIR and IIR filters in different signal environments.
positions.insights: Skills: MATLAB · Data Analysis · C (Programming Language) · Algorithms

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
•	My primary responsibility is to apply digital signal processing techniques to  analyze the performance of a specific subsection of an algorithm design, and propose / implement design changes that arise form the investigations.
•	Developed MATLAB based simulation tools to analyze data and reduce the time it take to generate key reports.
•	Performed case studies and presented results to senior engineers and manager to aid in our understanding of specific phenomena as they have impacted our design of new algorithms.
•	Assisted software development team with integration and unit testing of algorithms.
•	Design test plans and automation script for regression analysis.

volunteerExperiences.description: Took part in construction management of stone carved Hindu temple. Conducted weekly process meetings with various trades, researched and ordered materials and supervised carpentry contractors.

patents.title: Media Access Control Adress Identification
patents.description:
Auto Pairing Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and Classic Bluetooth Channel on Mobile Device
Created process to identify BLE channel associated with classic Bluetooth channel and auto pair BLE accessory with mobile device.

patents.title: ON/OFF Head Detection Using Magnetic Field Sensing
patents.description: Using magnetic field of speaker driver, developed software solution to detect headset position.
